title: Contact page: timeline field, success-state replacement, aligned layout, and reused client marquee
body:
This updates only the existing Contact page while preserving its current visual system, two-column structure, Formspree endpoint, and submission flow. It applies the requested UX/content changes: new timeline input, improved column start alignment, success-state replacement behavior, and homepage client marquee reuse. - **Form copy + field additions** - Submit CTA text changed to **“Start the conversation”** (styling unchanged). - Added optional **Project timeline** select between **Type of Project** and **Message** using matching form markup/classes. - Timeline options added in required order with placeholder: `Select a timeframe...`. - **Layout alignment (no redesign)** - Kept the existing two-column composition and content order. - Reduced excess top whitespace and aligned left content/right form to begin at comparable vertical position beneath the page heading. - **Success-state behavior (replace, not append)** - Success panel is hidden on initial load with no reserved space. - On successful Formspree response, form fields + submit button are hidden and replaced by a minimal confirmation panel: - `✓` - `Thanks for getting in touch.` - `I’ll get back to you within 24 hours.` - Existing inline error-path behavior remains intact; non-JSON error responses now safely fall back without losing explicit API error messages. - **Homepage marquee reuse on Contact** - Added **Selected clients** heading and inserted the same homepage marquee block directly above the footer. - Reused identical logo set/track structure for matching animation/sizing/responsive behavior. - Duplicate loop items are hidden from assistive tech to prevent repeated logo announcements. ```html

✓

Thanks for getting in touch.

I’ll get back to you within 24 hours.

```
